description: This file manages agent wait states and deduplication logic for terminal snapshots, including waiters management, snapshot reading, and event handling for agent and chat run IDs.

methods.name: parseRunIdFromDedupeKey
methods.description: Extracts run ID from dedupe key based on prefix ('agent:' or 'chat:').

methods.name: asFiniteNumber
methods.description: Converts a value to a finite number if possible.

methods.name: removeWaiter
methods.description: Removes a waiter callback from the waiters set for a given run ID.

methods.name: addWaiter
methods.description: Adds a waiter callback to the waiters set for a given run ID and returns a function to remove it.

methods.name: notifyWaiters
methods.description: Calls all waiter callbacks associated with a run ID.

methods.name: readTerminalSnapshotFromDedupeEntry
methods.description: Reads and interprets a terminal snapshot from a dedupe entry.

methods.name: readTerminalSnapshotFromGatewayDedupe
methods.description: Retrieves the latest terminal snapshot for a run ID, considering chat and agent entries.

methods.name: waitForTerminalGatewayDedupe
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for a terminal snapshot to become available or timeout.

methods.name: setGatewayDedupeEntry
methods.description: Sets a dedupe entry and notifies waiters if a snapshot is available.
